Returns the widget-tree root widget. Collects every widget in this widget tree. @param Widgets Receives the widget array. Returns the geometry allotted to the current paint pass. Resolves a named color from the active core style set. Resolves a named brush from the active core style set. Returns the default core-style font at Size points.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Use the returned reference in a follow-up mutation or identity check to prove aliasing. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both.
inputs: Known positive and negative receiver states, empty/default state, exact lookup keys, and boundary values implied by the listed signatures.
